dex.entry: A mid-sized dream-ram whose crescent horns have grown into proper moon-arcs that hum with soporific resonance; anything caught near it during its slow, dreamy patrol gradually loses focus. Peaceful but quietly menacing — it doesn't fight you, it just makes you forget you wanted to.

art.silhouette: Stocky ram silhouette, deep slate-blue wool, full crescent moon-arc horns lit with cool silver, half-lidded star-pupils, trail of floating dream-motes; calm and commanding at 48px.
